title: 5 Massive OpenAI Updates
description:
Number one, GPT-5.6. Their new flagship model family, Sol, Terra, and Luna, built for more performance per dollar than the last one.

Number two, GPT-Live. A new voice model that can actually listen and talk at the same time instead of waiting its turn.

Number three, ChatGPT Work. Their answer to Claude Cowork, it connects to your actual tools and finishes real tasks instead of just answering questions.

Number four, the ChatGPT app itself changed. Codex merged right into it, and their standalone Atlas browser is getting shut down because of it.

And finally, GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model inside Microsoft 365 Copilot, so it's already in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint whether you opened ChatGPT or not.


GPT-5.6 → openai.com/index/gpt-5-6
GPT-Live → openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-live
ChatGPT Work → openai.com/index/chatgpt-for-your-most-ambitious-work
